teacher_info.teaching_style: I believe language acquisition is best achieved when language is learned in the same context as it will be used. This encourages students to view language as a tool to negotiate and share meaning, rather than a set of words and rules to memorized. As a result, students learn in a way that will allow them to be confident using English outside the classroom.
